property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: 128 MB block size optimized for Big Data Parquet and MapReduce splits.

property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Set to 1 for single-DataNode local development cluster to prevent UNDER-REPLICATED block warnings. Production multi-node enterprise deployments must configure dfs.replication=3 across independent rack domains.

property.name: dfs.webhdfs.enabled
property.description: Enables WebHDFS HTTP REST API on port 9870 for automated pipeline ingestion.

property.name: dfs.permissions.enabled
property.description: Disabled in development sandbox to allow multi-user containerized access.
